Example inputs for plot_sv_reconstruction()

Source: R/data.R
ex_recon_inputs.Rd

A synthetic EGFR amplicon (sample "EXAMPLE01", chr7) carrying many duplication junctions across a wide read-support (VF) range, so plot_sv_reconstruction() can rebuild it wave by wave — a high-VF founder, then successively lower-VF waves. karyotype/gene_coord fall back to the bundled hg38 references.

Usage

ex_recon_inputs

Format

A named list of three data.frames — cnv_data, sv_data, wgd_data — matching the columns plot_sv_reconstruction() expects.

Source

Synthetic; generated by data-raw/make_example_data.R.

See also

plot_sv_reconstruction(), ex_plot_inputs

Examples

p <- plot_sv_reconstruction(
  sample   = "EXAMPLE01",
  cnv_data = ex_recon_inputs$cnv_data,
  sv_data  = ex_recon_inputs$sv_data,
  wgd_data = ex_recon_inputs$wgd_data,
  chromosome = "chr7"
)
